key_finding: Astera Labs is structurally a three-founder Texas-Instruments-alumni company built into a public AI-connectivity semiconductor with a board that has executed a clean IPO and is now configured for ongoing public-company governance through what will be a multi-cycle compute-architecture transition. The three co-founders (Mohan, Gajendra, Morrison) remain in their operating roles; Jitendra Mohan as CEO, Sanjay Gajendra as President/COO, Casey Morrison as Chief Product Officer. Manuel Alba — co-founder of Galileo Technology (sold to Marvell in 2001) — chairs the board and provides the deepest semiconductor M&A and connectivity-architecture pattern recognition. Craig Barratt (joined March 2025, days after stepping out of Intel CEO transition committee work, now Intel chairman-elect for May 2026) brings the most consequential single addition. Michael Hurlston (currently CEO of Lumentum, previously Synaptics, Finisar) connects the board to the optical and silicon CEO peer network. Stefan Dyckerhoff (Sutter Hill Ventures, the Series A lead) is the venture anchor with chip-systems operating credibility (Juniper EVP, Cisco VP/GM). Jack Lazar (ex-GoPro CFO, ex-Atheros CFO, current GlobalFoundries director) is the audit-committee chair. Bethany Mayer (ex-Ixia CEO, current Box chair, HPE and LAM Research director) brings the most cross-board breadth. Composition reads: founder-operators + four semiconductor-CEO-credentialed independents + one venture chair-of-Sutter + one full-time audit-grade CFO veteran. There is no special-purpose financial-engineering board member because IPO execution is already done.

board_of_directors.framing: Barratt is the most consequential single board addition of the past 18 months. He joined the Astera board in March 2025 and was simultaneously the lead board figure in the Intel succession process — designated as incoming Intel Chairman effective May 13, 2026. The Stanford EE PhD + Sydney undergraduate pedigree + Atheros (Qualcomm) + Barefoot (Intel) + Google Access background is precisely the experience set for an AI-rack-connectivity company. The Intel chairmanship overhang means he will likely manage time between Astera, Intel chair, and Intuitive Surgical — but as Astera's intersect with the Intel ecosystem grows, having him on the board matters.

board_composition_observation: The Astera board pairs three founder-operators with five independents whose CVs are concentrated in semiconductor/connectivity CEO experience and venture investing. Three of the five independents (Alba, Hurlston, Barratt) have personally led connectivity or accelerator silicon companies through full M&A or scale-up cycles. One (Dyckerhoff) is the lead investor partner with Cisco/Juniper operating experience. One (Lazar) is the public-company-CFO veteran. One (Mayer) is the most cross-board-experienced. The composition reflects a company that has already executed its IPO (March 2024) and is now configured for cycle-compression governance through the Rubin / next-Nvidia-architecture transition rather than for additional financial-engineering or M&A. The absence of an investment-banking or specialist-restructuring board member is not a gap — it is a confirmation that the operating model is what the company is running on.
